action_items.action: In the claim narrative or a new immutable supplement, state that H1 is supported for validation LPIPS and that H2 is a matched-update configuration intervention with count/runtime mediation. Include secondary-metric regressions, depth support/completeness, prior validation exposure, temporal dependence, and multiple-comparison optimism. Preserve the frozen study.

Resolved by experiments/reconstruction-quality-1/verification/replay-result-v2.json:3. All three baseline discrepancy checks are present and independently verified. Retain this supplement alongside the immutable original report; no training or original-output rewrite is required.
Clarify that the largest signed paired-degradation selections have negative deltas and therefore show least improvement, while preserving the deterministic selection rule and frame IDs.
Update the tracker after consuming this review with WARN, same-family, provisional status; do not mark cross-family independence or unrestricted acceptance.

Any claim about isolated objective effects at fixed density, equal-time efficiency, portable speed, or unseen-scene generalization requires a new preregistered experiment; the current data do not establish these claims.

auditor: Fresh secondary Codex reviewer; model identity not independently asserted

A.details: RGB and axial-Z depth references are dataset sensor observations from the real TUM sequence, not reconstruction outputs. All 1,072 staged RGB references were compared to resized dataset pixels. Training uses only 50 train frames; study evaluation uses exactly the frozen 16 validation frames. Detector agreement uses learned detector outputs on both domains and is explicitly disclaimed as accuracy. No official TUM reconstruction leaderboard or official evaluation claim was found.
A.name: Ground-truth provenance

B.details: No deceptive self-max score rescaling found. RGB uses fixed 255/1 ranges; LPIPS uses fixed [-1,1] input scaling; relative-depth training divides by GT clamped at 0.05 m; detector center error uses camera width/height. Depth MAE/RMSE condition on positive finite predictions and alpha>=0.1, so their mean denominator is a prediction-dependent support count. This is disclosed, with raw support counts and GT-denominator completeness, but prevents interpreting lower depth error alone as all-pixel geometry improvement. The LPIPS SVG maximum only scales its labeled plotting axis and does not alter raw metrics.
B.name: Score normalization

C.details: All 24 planned new training runs and 67 complete 16-view evaluations exist; all 91 ledger records are complete. All checked source/spec/data/history/model/checkpoint/render/evaluation/analysis hashes match. Frozen source equals recorded commit; specification commit precedes source commit, seal, and execution. All 63 snapshot ages/prefix logs/final tensor equalities are consistent. All 1,072 CPU metric replays and all summary, table, aggregate, selection and failure-selection checks passed; ten independent LPIPS forwards matched within 4.470348358154297e-8. No missing arms or fabricated results found. The original immutable report emits standalone-vs-trajectory discrepancy checks only for seed 42, but the subsequently supplied verification/replay-result-v2.json records all three seeds and resolves the reporting-completeness gap. Its deltas, verifier hash, 91 ledger hashes, runtime sums/span and allocator maxima were independently verified; all three seeds pass the stated tolerances. Audit status in tracker remains pending at the audited snapshot, correctly describing unfinished assurance.
C.name: Results, provenance, completeness, and timing

D.details: Study loss branches and RGB/depth/LPIPS/detector metrics are actually invoked and appear in saved per-view outputs, predictions, and convergence logs. MSE and GT-valid-mask variants are supported/tested code, explicitly outside the frozen study; they are not represented as empirical ablation arms. Geometry Chamfer/F-score remain explicitly unavailable, not phantom measurements. CPU/GPU acceptance-test source was inspected; this audit did not rerun or independently substantiate the tracker historical test-count assertions.
D.name: Dead code and executed variants

E.details: One previously exposed capture, three seeds, seven arms and three correlated checkpoints per trajectory support descriptive validation results only. Existing scope disclaimers are appropriate. Selection compares 21 checkpoints per seed on the same 16 views and is optimistic; no independent test generalization or significance claim is supported. Objective changes alter densification and realized counts, so matched-update comparisons are not equal-time or equal-count effects. Local serial timings are measurements, not a randomized portable speed benchmark. Aggregate secondary-metric tradeoffs need explicit narrative: LPIPS improvements are not universal SSIM/depth improvements. All largest-paired-degradation cases have negative signed deltas, so they are least-improved views rather than actual LPIPS regressions.
E.name: Scope and strength of claims

F.details: Photometric and depth evaluation: real_gt (real dataset RGB and measured sensor depth; LPIPS is a learned comparison metric, not a generated reference). Detector consistency: synthetic_proxy in the checklist taxonomy, specifically a learned-detector agreement proxy with predictions on real images as reference; it is not annotated detection accuracy. Analytic synthetic smoke fixtures are implementation tests only and do not contribute to this study. No simulation_only or human_eval study outcome is claimed. No learned image/depth reference is substituted for sensor observations.
F.name: Evaluation type

claims.details: All 21 trajectories improve mean validation LPIPS at both 1200->2400 and 2400->3600. Control mean LPIPS is 0.3287577784309785, 0.29819653028001386, 0.2828733666489522; paired 3600-1200 delta -0.04588441178202629, with mean cumulative optimization time increasing by 16.087380805000674 s. This is not universal fidelity improvement: depth-off mean depth MAE worsens by 0.004889159410621027 m and L1+SSIM mean SSIM decreases slightly (-0.000760219648341757) from 1200 to 3600. No test/generalization/independent-checkpoint claim.
claims.support: supported for descriptive validation LPIPS; mixed for broader fidelity

claims.details: At 3600, L1+SSIM mean LPIPS 0.24201181065291166 versus control 0.2828733666489522 (paired delta -0.04086155599604056), mean counts 23016.666666666668 versus 17945, mean optimization time 30.962186675000947 versus 25.252110198998707 s, and supported depth MAE 0.08338124520816641 versus 0.08205843608414129 m. Cap20k produces roughly 11369 splats and worse LPIPS, despite control also ending below nominal 20k: growth gating at twice current count is the operative intervention. SH2 improves LPIPS; depth-off and relative-depth do not dominate control. Selected same-validation results are descriptive, not unbiased estimates.
claims.support: supported for configuration-level tradeoffs at matched updates; not isolated equal-capacity/equal-time effects

evaluation_types.detector_agreement: synthetic_proxy (learned detector agreement, not object ground truth)

limitations: The audit verifies present artifacts and source paths; it cannot prove absence of every prior human/agent exposure or unlogged off-path computation. The study already discloses prior sequence exposure.
No new training or rasterization run was performed. Historical acceptance-test counts were not rerun by this reviewer.
LPIPS inference was independently replayed on ten named saved new-study pairs, not all 1072. All 1072 saved LPIPS predictions were checked against view metrics and aggregates.
Public dataset source authenticity is assessed from local acquisition provenance and observed real imagery; no fresh download or upstream archive re-acquisition was performed.
reviewer_model_attestation: Requested through spawn_agent; not independently attested
scope: Read-only audit of listed local primary artifacts; only review.md and review.json written. Historical result contents were not consumed; historical files verified by opaque hashes.
summary: Primary measurements, provenance, complete matrix, checkpoint ages, numeric summaries and selection reproduce. No evidence of fabricated results, unlabeled reconstruction-derived GT, deceptive self-normalization, or candidate/test-driven code selection was found. The baseline-check reporting gap is resolved by a separate verified supplement; conditional-depth/count/runtime/selection limitations still require qualifiers.

verification.selection: all three reproduced from complete frozen validation candidates
verification.supplementary_replay: source/result/ledger hashes, all-seed baseline discrepancies, time sums/span, allocator maxima independently verified
